summary: Pin is in steep dense bush; the garden road beside it has no parking.
reasons: Dense bush, no track or vehicles

drivers.seclusion: No buildings within 100 m and heavily wooded, but nowhere a van could stand off the road.
drivers.access_and_room: No track or tyre marks reach the pin. The garden road 25 m east is a through route with yellow edge lines and a grass strip on the bank side; the small car park 86 m south is the visitor car park with marked bays.

flags: Yellow edge lines on the road suggest no stopping
sun_shade: Full tree canopy over the pin.
cannot_judge: Meaning of the yellow edge lines on site
Overnight rules at the small car park to the south
